messages:
Harper Liu: Dropping a small design proposal for the latency panel—Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/latency-annotations

Goals:
- Make p95 and throughput visible without forcing a resize: p95 headline left, throughput micro-spark above the heatmap.
- Move sampling into the timepicker row as a compact dropdown labeled 'Sampling' with presets Off / 10% / 25% / 100% + Custom.
- Add an inline 'Sampled' pill next to the chart title when sampling != Off; pill shows percent and opens a persistent help region for a11y.
- Add a small 'annotation' affordance: users can pin a note to any vertical slice (e.g., release marker) and it renders as a thin line with a tooltip.

Marcus Bennett: Nice direction. A few quick items:
- Inline pill should read "Sampled • 10%" (dot separator). Show exact percent in DOM so it's copyable.
- Tooltip copy: "Sampled view shows a subset of requests; numbers are approximate." Keep it single sentence.
- For annotations, ensure they don't occlude the heatmap colors—use a 1px dashed stroke plus hover label."

+ "Sofia Alvarez: Accessibility/keyboard thoughts:
- Sampling dropdown must be button+listbox role, current selection visible in DOM.
- Pill needs aria-describedby that points to the help region's text node (not hover-only).
- Annotation pins must be reachable: allow focus on pin via Tab and Enter to open details. Provide aria-label like 'Annotation: deploy v3.2 at 11:22 UTC'.
- Contrast: pill background should keep text contrast >= AA; use dark text on pale background.

Ravi Shah: Implementation/metrics:
- Telemetry: attach sampling_percent and annotations list to each query so we can reproduce views.
- If sampling is applied globally vs per-chart we need a clear indicator in the header.
- For annotation saving, confirm we store user, timestamp, and optional link to incident/ticket.

a11y-bot: Checklist added to INFR-4599:
- [ ] Sampling dropdown accessible pattern + visible DOM text
- [ ] 'Sampled • X%' pill with aria-describedby and persistent help region
- [ ] Annotation pins keyboard focusable with descriptive aria-labels
- [ ] Pill and annotation contrast meets AA
- [ ] Sampling_percent added to query metadata for telemetry

Harper Liu: I'll update Figma with the dashed annotation variant and add the help region content. Planning a 15m playtest Thurs 2pm PT to validate keyboard flow and small-screen collapse. Invite: @Sofia Alvarez @Marcus Bennett @Ravi Shah."
